description: Only the Strata base image. GitHub Actions are Dependabot's job (.github/dependabot.yml).

customManagers.description: Strata version in the Dockerfile; every flavor is built from it, so it is checked against the default flavor's tags (e.g. 0.2.12-cuda13). A release without images (like 0.2.10) is never proposed.

prBodyNotes: The web UI depends on some Strata internals. Before merging, go through `AI/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, section 15 (what to check after a Strata update), and test on a real card. CI builds every flavor but has no GPU.
